messages:
maria: quick heads-up — during a rotation rollback simulation in staging i hit multiple snapshot restores that fail to decrypt. tagging @encops. please advise.
ajay: :eyes: can you paste the exact error you saw from the restore tool?
maria: restore-tool --run --snapshot gs://staging-backups/db-2026-03-... --target /tmp/restore
maria: error: DecryptFailed: AccessDeniedException: InvalidCiphertext or grant not present
sophia: are these CMKs the same ones we rotated earlier today? any grant TTLs involved?
ajay: two quick checks: 1) confirm key state (Enabled/Disabled/Destroyed) 2) check if ephemeral grants were pruned by the grant-pruner job
ajay: e.g. aws kms describe-key --key-id arn:aws:kms:...; aws kms list-grants --key-id ...
jamal: also check bucket object metadata — sometimes the sse-cmek hint was stripped on archive replication
jamal: gsutil ls -L gs://staging-backups/db-2026-03-... | grep -i kmsKeyName
maria: confirmed CMK state: Enabled. list-grants shows only 1 long-lived grant, but restore was created under a short-lived grant that timed out
sophia: that matches: grant TTL was 5m in canary config; pruner runs every 10m, race condition.
ajay: ok likely root cause = ephemeral grant got created, then pruner removed it before restore completed. we should: 1) increase grant TTL for restores 2) patch pruner to exclude active restore jobs
ajay: for immediate unblock — create a grant back for the principal used by restore-controller:
ajay: aws kms create-grant --key-id <key> --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/restore-controller --operations Decrypt --retiring-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/restore-controller
maria: created temporary grant, re-ran restore — decrypt progressed past metadata but now failing at some chunk with InvalidCiphertext
jamal: that could be re-encryption mismatch from replication. check snapshot checksum vs archive manifest and verify object parts weren't re-encoded
jamal: run: sha256sum /tmp/parts/* and compare to manifest
sophia: we should also query audit logs for Decrypt/GenerateDataKey for that key around the time: gcloud/CloudTrail queries
ajay: CloudTrail sample: aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=<key-id> --max-results 50
encops-bot: INCIDENT-TRACKER: created INC-2026-031 for 'staging snapshot decrypt failures' assigned to encops
maria: plan: (1) keep temp grant for active restores (2) run full manifest checksum (3) add pruner whitelist for restore-controller role (4) adjust grant TTL to 30m
sophia: also add an observability alert: if a Decrypt call succeeds then subsequent access fails for same request id, warn.
ajay: please add a short blameless postmortem template entry. I'll schedule a quick canary run once fix is in prod-config
maria: thanks all. jamal, can you run the manifest check and paste results here? will keep the temp grant until we confirm
jamal: running now, sharing output in a sec
maria: :thumbsup:
